invariants: A path is removed only after the new owner has taken responsibility and no real consumer or compatibility obligation remains.

remove: The prior cleanup-only framing in README and the stale historical evidence bindings that rejected current verification.

retain.removal_condition: Remove or regenerate only when a new preregistered effect experiment supersedes V9.
retain.observability: V9 manifest and isolation audit hash

safeguards.name: dynamic-reference guard
safeguards.rationale: Unknown dynamic or generated paths cannot be deleted from an empty direct-reference result.

safeguards.name: compatibility retention guard
safeguards.rationale: A retained path must name a consumer, expiry, observability, and test.

safeguards.name: historical evidence binding
safeguards.rationale: Historical hashes point to the real prior commit instead of being silently rebound to current bytes.

design_boundary.rationale: SKILL.md owns the normative cleanup contract; README, metadata, template, reference, tests, and evidence are synchronized consumers.

dependency_audit.rationale: No new dependency was added; the workflow reuses existing Git, unittest, pytest replay, and Skill validator tooling.

extension_decision.rationale: This change strengthens an existing policy surface and adds no runtime extension point.

data_ownership.rationale: No mutable business or personal data path was changed.

error_model.rationale: Unresolved cleanup references are explicit unknowns; failed verification is a blocker rather than a passing claim.

contract_evolution.rationale: Existing Skill consumers remain compatible; the frozen V9 snapshot is retained with an explicit removal condition.

operational_budget.rationale: The policy text and deterministic tests do not alter a production resource budget.

threat_boundary.rationale: The cleanup contract prevents unsafe deletion of dynamic or externally consumed paths and prevents stale documentation from misleading future agents.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The change is kept in one reviewable commit after tests and diff checks.

release_recovery.rationale: No deployable runtime or release configuration changed.

data_migration.rationale: No database or persistence schema changed.

configuration_secrets.rationale: No runtime secret or environment contract changed.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: No package or lockfile dependency was added or upgraded.

operational_knowledge.rationale: README, enforcement reference, ledger template, and review record explain the cleanup workflow and evidence boundary.

reproducibility.rationale: The focused and full unittest commands, Skill validator command, and pinned replay tool discovery are recorded.
